nodes.meaning:
The council vote is the formal process by which the Ellsworth Falls Village Council decides on an ordinance. It requires a quorum of three members physically present, and adoption requires at least three affirmative votes from the full five-member council. The vote occurs at the regular session on 8 September 2026 as per the agenda, unless the sponsor moves postponement.
The formal adoption occurs when the vote is counted and meets the charter requirement.
